defect: An upload whose revision transaction returned 409 remained in the legacy Storage listing although opening it returned 409; it was not a committed saved contour.
fix: One owner-scoped batch read of contour_revisions identifies committed records without downloading their photos. Only unindexed keys read their blob: legacy PNGs remain visible; schema-2 uncommitted blobs are filtered. Pagination follows raw Storage page offsets. Metadata/Storage outages cannot silently turn schema-2 history into an empty success. Flutter allows advancing an empty filtered page.
production_status: Fix tested locally/isolated; deployment and post-deploy retained-fixture verification belong to the final root integration evidence.

flutter.new_test: Empty first filtered page with next_offset=50 remains navigable; next committed record loads and opens original and PNG controls.
